story_type: hoist camera over a pot-loaded fishing boat in whitecaps, litter hoist of a hurt deckhand off Alaska
hook: 74 miles off Kodiak, a deckhand was hurt at sea.
narration: Seventy four miles off Kodiak, Alaska, a deckhand was hurt on a fishing boat at sea.
Deck rigging had struck him in the head aboard the seventy nine foot Pacific Star.
The operator called the Coast Guard, and a Jayhawk crew from Air Station Kodiak flew out.
First, the flight mechanic lowered a rescue swimmer down to the deck.
The pilots cannot see straight down, so the mechanic talks them over the boat, one command at a time.
Then a rescue litter went down, onto a deck stacked high with pots.
[short pause] The swells kept shifting the boat under the cable.
The swimmer strapped the deckhand in, and the litter rose off the deck.
outcome: The Air Station Kodiak crew hoisted the injured deckhand off the Pacific Star, then brought their swimmer back up.
title: Hurt deckhand hoisted 74 miles off Kodiak
description:
On June 25, 2016, a Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew from Air Station Kodiak hoisted an injured fisherman from the 79-foot fishing vessel Pacific Star about 74 miles southeast of Kodiak, Alaska.
